sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks rows 2-54, specifically A42:D42; Deterministic Checks rows 2-49; Internal Quality Checks A42:E42
evidence: The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks A42:D42 asks for binary pass/fail behaviors and anchored Likert craft. Internal E42 says Likert is not used; SKILL.md:65 expressly resolves that historical annotation in favor of the shipped Likert format, consistent with quality-checks.md:168-170. Direct TOML parsing found 1 binary render gate, 1 binary constraints gate, 145 binary Functional outcomes, 4 binary Polish recovery outcomes, and 5 Likert Visual criteria, each points=5. All Functional descriptions were read: they ask for observable authorization, input acceptance/refusal, exact financial results, stored state, atomicity, history or persistence, not degrees of craft. Polish judge.toml:23,32,41,50 measures retained inputs and successful recovery; its prompt.md:10 explicitly says recovery, not visual craft. Visual judge.toml:20-29,35-44,50-59,65-74,80-89 supplies every level 1 through 5 for typography, palette/contrast, spacing, hierarchy and component consistency. For example typography distinguishes clear consistent type at 5, minor alignment/size issues at 4, noticeable inconsistency/crowding at 3, important labels difficult to read at 2, and broad illegibility at 1. These fit instruction.md:5 desktop clarity without forcing a particular design. Visual prompt.md:8 uses minimum raw 1 for failed operational prerequisites and otherwise directs the five anchors; its line 10 permits differing labels/layout/styles and requires independent visual observations. Broken-app challenge: a successful refusal that erases a distinct edited signing value must fail binary hro_pol_preserve_revision; merely attractive error styling cannot earn its credit. A working but crowded/illegible workspace gets the described lower typography/layout anchors rather than a binary craft pass. Conforming alternative: an app preserving a rescission date in a read-only confirmation with Retry remains valid under Polish judge.toml:32; an otherwise clear differently styled desktop with a minor alignment defect can get typography 4 instead of failing outright. No concrete broken-pass or conforming-fail case caused by scoring-type choice was found.
